title: Somnium Engine P-004 — L2 verifier gate (second canon genericity challenge)
description: Independent L2 review of P-004 (branch generic, commits 2206d10 / 32a517a / 1c7565a on merged baseline d83e84e). Two gates: REJECT then APPROVE. The rejection was a third recurrence of the documentation-claim defect class, on the change's own headline result.

findings: B1 verrin-adversarial.ts:28-35 asserted the fixture passes validateCanon with zero errors and that ev/adv-unspecified was declared in Canon.unspecified. Both false — the canon body never set the key; 5 errors on HEAD.
B2 report 18.7 asserted 'All three canons now validate with zero errors' — false for the adversarial fixture.
non_blocking: the one-engine source scan matches only double-quoted id literals
report 18.4 forward-referenced 18.7 for the hashing decision that landed as 18.9
gate_history.other_claims: all PASS — two canons through one engine, predictions scored honestly with 18.3 byte-identical pre/post implementation, fact-node defect reproduced at the parent commit, ALTERED fix a strict superset, two-hash split with hash removed not aliased and src/timeline byte-unchanged, ten capabilities parameterized with no skips, both 18.8 semantics claims verified by execution, determinism intact

gate_history.note: Both blocking findings closed and independently reproduced. Exhaustive repo-wide recurrence sweep over src/, tests/, docs/, qms/: zero SURVIVING refuted claims; every hit accurate at HEAD or past-tense naming the error it replaced. The negative test confirms the zero-error result is earned by the declaration rather than by the validator having stopped checking.

verifier_judgement_on_rewritten_tests: The two canon.test.ts cycle tests were rewritten from 'reports an error' to 'reports a NOTICE'. Judged legitimate corrections, verified independently rather than accepted: P-003 had already made both cycle kinds tested engine behaviours, so a validator calling them fatal contradicted shipped code. The rewritten tests are also stronger — they still assert the cycle is detected and named with both endpoints, and add the negative assertion that it is not in errors.
verifier_judgement_on_self_assessment: Report 18.10's claim that Verrin alone would have left the architecture 'wrong in three places' was checked item by item. Two (fact-node defect, ALTERED rule) were reproduced at the parent commit. The third (validator divergence) was accurately diagnosed but inaccurately reported as fixed at the first gate — which is what ncr-003 records.
